mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, summary_version, previous_summary_id, covered_start_turn_no, covered_end_turn_no, summary_content, summary_token_estimate, compression_level, model_call_id, provider_code, route_id, api_protocol, model_name, prompt_version, prompt_hash, status, create_time, update_time FROM conversation_summary WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_summary ( conversation_id, summary_version, previous_summary_id, covered_start_turn_no, covered_end_turn_no, summary_content, summary_token_estimate, compression_level, model_call_id, provider_code, route_id, api_protocol, model_name, prompt_version, prompt_hash, status ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{summaryVersion}, #{previousSummaryId}, #{coveredStartTurnNo}, #{coveredEndTurnNo}, #{summaryContent}, #{summaryTokenEstimate}, #{compressionLevel}, #{modelCallId}, #{providerCode}, #{routeId}, #{apiProtocol}, #{modelName}, #{promptVersion}, #{promptHash}, #{status} )
